name: print-social-sticker-collage-resume-cover-2026
title: Resume cover with letter-mixed title, paper clips and cutting mat
whatItIs: A crumpled graph-paper background with a dark green cutting mat corner. A polaroid-style photo is clipped with bulldog and paper clips and has a 'HELLO my name is' sticker. A browser-window bar holds a title 'Resume' in mixed coloured letters over a cut-out ransom-note style, with '2026' in an outlined tag and a stylus at the bottom.
whatItMeans: Playful and handmade; designer's desk objects give personality to a CV.
techniques: Build a collage of desk objects (clips, mat, stylus) as the frame.
Mix letter styles and colours in one word like a ransom note.
Use a fake app window bar for the title.
Add starburst stickers in bright pinks and blues.

vocabulary.definition: Each letter in a different style and colour.
A layout made from office and studio objects.
A green grid mat used as a background.
